# The Toll Road

The toll road runs south from Greymoor to Blackmoor. Four bridges, two
toll gates, and a goblin nesting ground somewhere in the second stretch.

The road is safe enough. The second bridge is not: the goblin ambush
happened there, and the goblins know the road's schedule.

Related: [[Session 3 - the Toll Road]], [[Greymoor]]
